description: This is a C# source file that sets up an Orleans application with custom configuration, dependency injection, and a background service for load testing. It defines a grain interface and implementation related to rebalancing, and configures Orleans clustering and placement options.

classes.name: LoadDriverBackgroundService
classes.description: A background service that performs load testing by repeatedly calling the Ping method on grains.

classes.name: RebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IRebalancingTestGrain, used for rebalancing testing with a collection age limit.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: The main execution loop of the background service, repeatedly calling Ping on grains.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method in the grain interface and implementation that completes immediately, used for testing.
